name: Custom server (generic)
description: A starting point for any game: copy this template, then set the image, the install script, the startup command, the variables and the ports for your server.

install.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd /data
echo "Nothing to install. Edit this template's install script to download your server files."

startup: sh -c 'echo "Replace the startup command in the template"; sleep 3600'
